# Tako

> Tako is a data intelligence platform. The Tako MCP server lets AI agents search a proprietary, continuously-updated knowledge base of 100K+ curated charts (latest reported quarter, same-day market prices, official releases as they publish) together with the live web, discover data coverage, fetch underlying rows or page text, and optionally visualize data or run a multi-step Answer Agent.

## Install (agent instructions)

Connect an MCP client to `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). No token is needed: paste the URL and sign in when the client prompts — a per-host key is minted automatically, and a new account gets up to 2,000 free requests. One command per major client:

- Claude Code (plugin, includes research skills): `claude plugin marketplace add TakoData/tako-mcp && claude plugin install tako@tako`
- Claude Code (plain): `claude mcp add tako --transport http https://mcp.tako.com/mcp` (then `/mcp` → tako → Authenticate)
- Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/TakoData/tako-mcp` (then `/mcp auth tako`)
- Cursor / Windsurf / VS Code / OpenCode: add `{"type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.tako.com/mcp"}` to the client's MCP config and sign in when prompted
- Codex CLI / Zed: bridge with `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.tako.com/mcp`
- ChatGPT: install the Tako app from the app directory, or hand-add `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp/chatgpt` as a custom connector (that surface is OAuth-only)
- CI / headless / Roo Code / Warp: send `Authorization: Bearer <TAKO_API_KEY>` on the same URL (keys: tako.com/console/api-keys)

Anonymous connections work immediately: `tako_search` runs (rate-limited, shared capacity); every other tool stays listed and answers with sign-in instructions when called.

## Tools

- Default: `tako_search` (data + web search — it locates data; `tako_contents` reads it), `tako_available_data` (free coverage check — run it to get a metric's exact name, then search on that name), `tako_contents` (the rows behind an `exportable: true` card, or a web page's text), `tako_graph_related` (free — explore a resolved node's metrics, covered entities, competitors, memberships, sources).
- Opt-in via `?tools=` on the URL — an allowlist of tool names that REPLACES the defaults (the `tako_` prefix is optional): `search_advanced` (`tako_search_advanced` — the whole v3 search body: per-source counts, inline rows, graph pins, web domain and date filters, `effort: deep`, plus `include_answer` for one synthesized, citation-backed answer and `output_schema` for structured output), `agent` (`tako_agent`, the multi-step Answer Agent), `visualize` (`tako_visualize`; listed by default on `/mcp/chatgpt`). Name the defaults you rely on too, e.g. `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp?tools=search,available_data,contents,agent`. Unknown values are ignored. Full reference: https://github.com/TakoData/tako-mcp/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md
